comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/sketch-esc-leaves.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1623): Sketch1 (F1) on XY with a 20 x 20 rectangle and Extrude1 (F2) after it: the new sketches start on Extrude1's top face (the origin planes' pick places can fall outside the view of a fitted body), and editing Sketch1 moves the timeline marker back.
